The merge vehicle is cutting in from the right (y=3.5m) to the ego lane (y=0.0m) at a forward distance of ~25.8m. The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph (~8.3 m/s), while the merging vehicle is at 7.5 m/s. Since the ego vehicle is faster and the merging vehicle is entering the ego's path, the ego vehicle must yield or slow down to allow the merge to complete safely. A2 typically represents a deceleration or yield action in this context, which is the appropriate response to a cut-in event where the ego is the faster vehicle.
